control_record.verifies: the band-3 reading of the 318 bookends after amendments 2-3 (option A + the tie-break): where the +11% goes

explanation: Option A, chosen by the GM for how it shapes the map (amendment 3), is the whole increase, and it has two parts. (1) The gap pass, gap_ways.lay_the_ways: switched off, the homesteads stage at 15 households sums 3.14 s against 6.41 s as landed and 4.42 s on main (control perf-318-control-gap-pass), so the pass costs 0.7-1.0 s a map and the rest of seating is cheaper than main - the tie-break. Its lane-ground chord test is now vectorized per the perf-audit (byte-identical, about half of lane_layers), taking the bookend from +11.3% to +7.9%. (2) The 20 ft homestead gap moves every layout, and the stages downstream of the layout shift with it in both directions: with main's gap and the gap pass kept, notice falls from 1.00 to 0.22 s on 20/47 and from 2.34 to 0.26 s on 40/39 but rises from 0.28 to 0.77 s on 15/4 and 0.10 to 0.61 s on 15/39, and seed 4's web (+0.4 s) and hinterland (+0.3 s) return to main's (0.56 s web, 0.90 s hinterland). Those swings are layout, not added work - the notice board's search is a lottery over where the houses fall, and the houses' extent shrank (20/47 859 -> 725 px). At 40 households the total is -10.7%: the web fell on every seed.
